summary: Onboarding Engine guarded service path (Issue #15 Milestone 2). Adds the SQL functions the app uses for every onboarding read and write: onboarding_create_batch, onboarding_register_artifact (intake only), onboarding_record_completion (stage result + run + control results in one transaction; status/open controls must equal the controls), onboarding_waive (human; sets the WAIVED disposition, status untouched), onboarding_approve (human; current preflight result), onboarding_advance (human; EXECUTE not reachable yet), onboarding_batch_view and onboarding_batches. Control results of onboarding runs become immutable except the one-time WAIVED disposition; conversion_runs.run_kind also allows intake/execute. Functions executable by service_role only. No rows change.

expected_changes: Creates functions onboarding_assert_actor, onboarding_create_batch, onboarding_register_artifact, onboarding_record_completion, onboarding_waive, onboarding_approve, onboarding_advance, onboarding_batch_view, onboarding_batches (EXECUTE to service_role only).

Creates function conversion_control_results_onboarding_guard + trigger trg_conversion_control_results_onboarding_guard (onboarding-run results immutable except a one-time WAIVED disposition from the matching human waiver; no delete; legacy dry_run results untouched).
Replaces conversion_runs_run_kind_check to also allow intake and execute.
